text:
February 7, 2019 Share
Looking into the technicals, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has scored 32% Buy indication. The stock is also flashing a Buy from the Barchart TrendSpotter trading system. Traders hoping to speculate on the AAPL’s short-term trajectory should know that short terms indicators for the stock averaged 60% Buy with an average daily trading volume over the past 20 days at 33692047 shares. AAPL stock has overall a 0.5% Buy signal considering medium term indicators and the 50-day average daily volume remained almost 41857852 40283844 shares, is 67% Sell $172.87. Below this, the next support is placed in the zone of $171.5. Till the time, the AAPL stock trades above this level, bulls have nothing to fear. On momentum oscillators front, ‘RSI’ has touched 66.67 on daily chart, which may remain a cause for concern. If the price breaks below $171.5 $175.59 mark may result into a pull-back move towards $176.94 level.
Apple Inc. (AAPL) is projected to climb by 2.57 $245 price as 12-month high target. This represents a whopping 40.61 $180, which represents a return potential of 3.31 percent when compared to the closing price of the stock of $174.24 on Wednesday, February 06. The price target has been raised from $165 to $150. Rosenblatt, analysts launched coverage of AAPL stock with a Neutral rating, according to their flash note to investors on January 30. Analysts at Morgan Stanley are sticking to their Overweight recommendation. However, on January 30, they lifted target price for these shares to $197 from $211.
